canonicalPreview.label: Hydroponic grow rack · 7832 tris
observations: Complete rack and feet fit inside the image.
Three plant tiers, blue frame, pale gutters and green crop are visible.
Title and 7832-triangle label are legible and match the required canonical label.

orthographicAndIsometric: Front and right views show three distinct tiers and the frame; all displayed whole-rack views fit inside their frames.
Top view shows the four rows of planting stations; no camera or geometry edits conceal the frame.
selectedPartDetails: The isolated lid has a continuous rectangular opening.
The end view of the isolated gutter shows an open U-shaped channel.
The planting-station detail shows the crop at the slotted lid.
The shortened knee brace lies below the gutter and intersects its frame members.
The middle post and crop have visible separation in the selected top view; numerical clearance belongs to the source/mesh checks.

video.observationMethod: Inspected the four decoded MP4 frames in decoded-orbit.webp, not continuous playback.
observations: Each decoded view shows a fully framed rack.
Opposite side views retain the frame, three plant tiers and drain/manifold scene geometry.
Labels are legible in all four sampled frames.
All ten frames show a complete three-tier rack without image-edge clipping; frame, feet, channels, lights and external plumbing remain within the view.
Each crop row grows visibly from0.7 to1.0 to1.3 with unchanged viewpoint and metres-to-pixels conversion. No per-state auto-fit masks the size change.
Lettuce shows distinct low-poly heads across all three tiers. Empty states remove foliage and retain the visible planting locations. Microgreens states replace heads with flat green mat geometry.
The four-color state visibly changes the frame to magenta, gutters to cyan-blue and foliage to yellow-green while keeping the default crop and size.
Labels and color legend remain readable; no overlapping text or blank/missing render cells observed.
parameterStates.fourthColorQualification: The light diffusers are small and partly occluded in the fixed overall view. Their orange control value is verified by actual COLOR_0/material sampling in the native validator; this sheet alone is not an independent clear view of every light surface.
limitations: The images show saved public GLBs through the repository software rasterizer; they do not establish live Studio WebGL or retained-handle parameter edits.
Uniform scale, crop branch and colors are visible. Independent engineering dimensions, structural strength, hydraulic performance and manufacturing suitability are not established.
Default details, canonical catalog preview and default orbit are owned by the publication lane and are not duplicated here.

independentReview: Root viewed canonical preview, default views, geometry details, the compact ten-state fixed-camera sheet and the four decoded orbit samples.
scope: No live Studio WebGL or continuous-video-playback claim. Numeric geometry checks are reported separately. The fourth light color is verified by mesh color values; its small surfaces are partly occluded in the overall parameter sheet.
